stories.title: A second Houthi strike hits Riyadh's airport, setting Terminal 4 ablaze a day after 12 died
stories.reason: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a cruise missile near the airport while a separate projectile struck the terminal and started a fire, extending the airport's closure and deepening the crisis that has Trump weighing direct US involvement against the Houthis.

stories.title: Trump says Ukraine should 'get a new president,' blaming Zelensky for high US fuel prices
stories.reason: The remarks, a day after Trump's diesel deal with Putin, accused Zelensky of worsening fuel costs by continuing strikes on Russian refineries, drawing a sharp rebuke from Kyiv's foreign minister even though martial law bars Ukraine from holding elections to replace him.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV announces he will have surgery to remove a nodule found on his lung
stories.reason: The Vatican says the nodule was caught early and the operation is scheduled for this week with about a week of hospitalization expected, raising questions over whether Leo will still preside over Wednesday's closing Mass as doctors say his planned Latin America trip should remain on track.

stories.title: Death toll from a migrant boat capsizing off Djibouti rises to 139, with dozens still missing
stories.reason: The vessel, carrying roughly 305 people toward Yemen, capsized overnight with 15 children among the dead and more than 80 survivors rescued, adding to a route the UN says has already claimed over 900 lives in 2025 alone.

stories.title: A Senate investigation finds Big Tech is pushing AI data centers' grid costs onto household electricity bills
stories.reason: A nearly yearlong probe by Senators Warren, Blumenthal and Van Hollen found Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft and other operators are not covering the full cost of grid upgrades their facilities trigger while using NDAs and seeking tax breaks, as a single gigawatt-scale data center can draw as much power as 100,000 homes.

stories.title: Leaders of India's 'Cockroach' youth protest movement are released from detention
stories.reason: Abhijeet Dipke and two other senior leaders were freed a day after police detained thousands and locked down Delhi to stop their march against election chief Gyanesh Kumar, though the movement's core grievance over the voter list revision remains unresolved.

stories.title: The Pentagon raises its official death toll from the Iran war to 21 service members, with 865 wounded
stories.reason: The revised Defense Casualty Analysis System count adds two noncombat deaths to the previous tally of 19, coming after the Washington Post reported the public database understated the true toll, a claim Defense Secretary Hegseth had called 'a complete lie.'

stories.title: The Middle East war and record global debt dominate the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
stories.reason: With public debt near its highest share of GDP since World War Two and the US-Israel war on Iran stretching into its eighth month, the IMF is set to downgrade growth forecasts for Ukraine and Gulf states while US Treasury Secretary Bessent skips the gathering entirely.
